uefi_memory_reasoning.helper_semantics: MemoryMapHelper only searches descriptors by name or exact address; it does not reserve or filter RAM.
uefi_memory_reasoning.pei_semantics: MemoryInitPei creates resource/allocation HOBs only for explicit memory descriptors.
uefi_memory_reasoning.dxe_semantics: giulia.fdf includes RamManagerDxe. It imports Base/AvailableLength from EFI_RAMPARTITION, subtracts existing EFI descriptors and adds uncovered gaps as EfiConventionalMemory.
uefi_memory_reasoning.baseline_conditional_result: Without the overlay, if firmware RAM partitions cover DSM/QLINK and no earlier EFI descriptor excludes them, RamManager attempts to add those gaps as conventional RAM.
uefi_memory_reasoning.overlay_fix: The repository now adds exactly three AddMem/MEM_RES/UNCACHEABLE/Reserv/UNCACHED_UNBUFFERED_XN descriptors before RamManager. prepare verifies the qualified post-board-patch baseline or exact previous overlay, copies the overlay, and verifies DSC/INF/FDF wiring.
uefi_memory_reasoning.not_proven: Source reservation does not establish SCM permission, secure-domain ownership, an observed final EFI/ADT map or absence of prior firmware writes.
uefi_memory_reasoning.next_input: Verify the built artifact contains the qualified overlay and retain final memory/ADT ownership evidence before assigning DSM.

qualification.note: Factory ROM bytes remain private local cache; this artifact contains only provenance and structural metadata.

uefi_memory_overlay.scope: PEI HOB/MMU descriptor reservation before RamManager gap filling; not SCM permission or live ownership proof
